original_annotations.narration: Pick up the bag of dishwasher tablets from the lower shelf of the cupboard.
open the bag by holding two ends of the bag and pulling them apart, opening the sealed bag.
pick up one tablet from the bag. The bag is being held with the left hand and the tablet is being picked up by inserting the right hand into the bag and pulling away one tablet.
Place the tablet inside the compartment, in the dishwasher's door,
Close the compartment of the dishwasher's door.

Close the bag of the dishwasher tablets by sealing the top again, pushing the two sides of the bag and with the hands ensuring the seal is back in place, passing the hand around along the seal to close it.
Put the back of the dishwasher's tablet in the lower shelf of the cupboard.
pick up the bottle of the dishwasher rinser from the upper shelf of the cupboard.
open the second compartment in the dishwasher by pressing the flap which opens it.
pour liquid from the bottle into the dishwasher's compartment by tilting the bottle on top of the compartment so water falls in place. Notice that the bottle has already been opened, so was open.
squeeze the bottle with both hands to make sure all the remaining liquid inside it is poured into the dishwasher's compartment.
Close the dishwasher's compartment by flipping its door back in place using the left hand.

observed_events.description: The wearer opens a Finish-branded pouch, removes a multicolour dishwasher detergent tablet or capsule, places it in the rectangular detergent compartment of the open dishwasher door, closes that compartment, and reseals the pouch.

The wearer takes a separate Finish-branded blue-label bottle, opens a different circular filling compartment, pours and squeezes the bottle into it, and closes that compartment. This is visually consistent with rinse-aid filling, not putting another detergent tablet in the first compartment.

supported_claims.text: The original tool rests across the mug and filters the poured drink while retaining loose leaves.
The retained leaves are then returned to the flask, demonstrating the separate brew-and-strain routine referenced by the authored change of method.

catalog_resolution.failure: The frozen licensed-catalog union contains neither required product form.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent replace an earlier means of achieving a physical goal when the user changes the desired routine, without carrying the obsolete purchase into the final cart?
construct.belief_before: The user wants a replacement for the visible across-mug pour-through tea strainer.
construct.belief_after: The user now wants to steep leaves inside the mug and remove them afterwards; the original pour-through tool is no longer requested.
construct.required_behavior_change: Remove the strainer and add one reusable mesh tea ball with a chain.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The initial unnamed tool and current routine are grounded in the pour-through action. The update names the newly desired product form, but the canceled item still comes from the scene.

instructions.a: Order a single spare of the tool I am using to catch the leaves while pouring this drink. It should rest across a mug in the same way; colour and brand do not matter.
instructions.b: Actually, I want to steep the leaves directly in my mug. Replace that with one reusable mesh tea ball with a chain, so I can lift the leaves out afterwards.
instructions.bundled: Order one reusable mesh tea ball with a chain for steeping loose leaves directly in a mug. Do not keep the separate pour-through strainer.

decision_draft.equivalence_rule: Before the update, accept equivalent single across-mug fine strainers. After it, accept every single reusable mesh tea ball with a chain and verified in-cup tea use, without brand or colour narrowing.
decision_draft.timing_rule: A strainer is valid work under A, then becomes obsolete only when the fixed replacement update arrives.

web_evidence_needed: Real canonical product details distinguishing a pour-through tea strainer from a chained mesh infuser used inside a mug.
Confirm mesh construction, attached retrieval chain, single-unit quantity and reusable tea-steeping purpose from public details; do not use visual resemblance alone.
Retain all equivalent landings in the frozen two-query union and validate removal of the former item in the native cart.
